spec.name: Madreperla Piano Accordion
spec.description: A 34-key Italian piano accordion lying on its base, with a wine-red bellows and cabinets tiled in a mosaic of iridescent mother-of-pearl celluloid, gold lines and chrome corner trim.
spec.layout: Scale: a real 34-key, 72-bass accordion, bellows slightly open. The bellows axis runs along x and the instrument rests on the flat bottoms of its two cabinets at y=0. Seen from the front (+Z): on the model's left (+X) is the taller TREBLE cabinet (x 0.17..0.31, y 0..0.46, z -0.14..0.14). Its +Z face carries a vertical piano keyboard. Each key is a strip lying along x with its top facing +Z, and the strips are stacked up the y axis (white keys 0.0165 m wide) from y=0.045 to y=0.40. On the right (-X) is the BASS cabinet (x -0.31..-0.17, y 0..0.44, z -0.14..0.14). Its +Z face carries a button board of round pearl buttons (6 columns x 8 rows). Between them is the BELLOWS (x -0.17..0.17, y 0.02..0.43, z -0.125..0.125), pleated like a concertina. Its folds are wine red, and each fold edge is trimmed in cream. Cream-pearl corner guards sit at all four long corners of the bellows. The back (-Z) carries the shoulder straps and the bass hand strap, which are leather. The outer end of the treble cabinet (+X face) holds a pearl-framed, perforated treble grille with a gold medallion. The outer end of the bass cabinet (-X face) holds a bass grille of vertical slots. Register switches in pearl and black sit in a row on the treble top (y=0.46) near the back edge. A chrome air-button lever sits on the bass top. STYLE: the cabinet faces are covered in mother-of-pearl mosaic. The tile is a thin square slab of about 0.024 m, with small variation, seated 2 mm proud of the cabinetBase face. Tiles cycle through pearlWhite, pearlCream, pearlPink, pearlAqua, pearlLilac and pearlGold, each with a slightly different size and a 1.5 mm gap showing the base. The tiles run in diagonal harlequin rows. Around each mosaic panel runs a 4 mm gold line, then a chrome edge. Thin nacreShadow slabs under each tile give a cool iridescent depth, and the warm tiles sit on top faces while the cool aqua and lilac tiles sit lower and on the shaded sides. Every vertical cabinet edge has a chrome angle strip. All parts share this mosaic recipe so the pattern reads as one celluloid skin. Everything is chunky, simple primitives with small details on top: tiles, buttons, screws, rivets, grille holes, gold fillets.

parts.builds: The right-hand cabinet as a cabinetBase box (x 0.17..0.31, y 0..0.46, z -0.14..0.14) with its pearl mosaic skin. The mosaic covers the top, the back, the bottom rim, the +X end panel framing and the strip of front face either side of the keyboard (the keyboard itself belongs to the 'keyboard' part). Also: gold fillet lines and chrome edge angles on all vertical edges; four small rubber feet in black at the bottom corners resting on y=0; the +X END GRILLE (a pearl-framed panel about 0.26 high and 0.20 deep, inset slightly, with a grilleDark backing and a perforated pattern of small holes or slots in nested arcs, a central gold medallion disc with a raised goldLight rim and a small star or scroll motif, and chrome screws at the corners); and the top-face REGISTER SWITCHES, a row of 7 small rocker pads (alternating pearlWhite and black, each with a thin chrome pivot pin) along the back edge of the top, with a gold nameplate strip in front of them. A bellows-clamp frame (chrome plate with four screws) on the -X face where the bellows meets.
parts.attaches: Its -X face at x=0.17 meets the bellows at mount bellowsTrebleEnd. Its front face (z=0.14) is where the keyboard part sits, at trebleFrontFace. Its back face (z=-0.14) is where the straps part attaches, at strapTrebleAnchor and trebleBackFace. Its bottom rests on y=0.

parts.builds: The piano keyboard on the treble front face. A fascia frame in nacreDeep with a gold inner fillet and a chrome edge surrounds the key well (x 0.185..0.295, y 0.03..0.42, z 0.14..0.152). Inside it, 21 ivory white keys in keyIvory with keyShadow undersides, each lying along x and 0.0155 m wide, stacked from y=0.045 to y=0.40 with 1 mm gaps, tops at z about 0.165. 14 black keys in keyBlack are narrower (0.009 m) and shorter in x, raised to z about 0.178, in the usual 2-3 grouping, each with a thin pearlWhite sheen sliver on its top. Two or three pearl 'key cheek' blocks sit at the ends of the key well, and a gold maker's name rail runs along the upper fascia edge. Everything is simple boxes.
parts.attaches: Backed flat against the treble cabinet front face (z=0.14) at mount trebleFrontFace; the key stack runs from keyboardBottom to keyboardTop.

parts.builds: The left-hand cabinet (x -0.31..-0.17, y 0..0.44, z -0.14..0.14) in cabinetBase with the same pearl mosaic recipe on the top, back and front rim. The +Z face has a BUTTON BOARD, a nacreDeep panel inset with a gold border. On it sit 6 columns x 8 rows of round pearl bass buttons (small cylinders, 0.011 m across, in pearlWhite, with two index buttons in black on the third row and a thin chrome ring under each). The rows are staggered slightly, and the buttons stand about 0.012 m proud of the board. The -X END has a BASS GRILLE, with a grilleDark backing and a pearl frame, with vertical slots carved by narrow dark slats and a gold medallion at the top. The top has a chrome AIR-BUTTON lever near the back (a base plate, a pivot and a pearl thumb pad), and four black rubber feet resting on y=0. Chrome edge angles on all vertical edges, plus the bellows-clamp plate with four screws on the +X face.
parts.attaches: Its +X face at x=-0.17 meets the bellows at mount bellowsBassEnd. Its back face (z=-0.14) receives the straps part at strapBassAnchor and bassBackFace. Its bottom rests on y=0.

parts.builds: The concertina bellows between the cabinets (x -0.17..0.17, y 0.02..0.43, z -0.125..0.125), slightly open. It has about 11 pleats, each a rectangular frame of wine-red panels folding in and out (alternating bellowsRed peaks and bellowsDark valleys, tapering a little in depth at the valley). Each fold edge on the front, back, top and bottom carries a thin bellowsEdge cream paper trim line. Two end frames in nacreDeep with gold fillets close the ends flush against the cabinets. The four long edges of the bellows carry cream-pearl CORNER GUARDS, a row of small pearlWhite/pearlPink/pearlAqua tile-like plates, one per fold, over a gold or chrome folded corner strip (x from -0.17 to 0.17, at z=±0.125, y=0.02 and 0.43). On the front a leather bellows strap crosses the middle fold (leather with stitch seams, a chrome buckle and a goldLight rivet), the latch hook on the bass side. A small gold maker's badge sits centred on the front.
parts.attaches: End frames are flush with the cabinets at mounts bellowsTrebleEnd (x=0.17) and bellowsBassEnd (x=-0.17). Floats above the floor (bottom at y=0.02), carried by the cabinets.

parts.builds: Everything on the back (-Z side) of the instrument. Two padded leather SHOULDER STRAPS, one over each side of the treble top and bass top, with a chrome slide buckle and a leatherLight pad each. They run in simple chunky rod/slab segments looping down the back toward y=0.08 at z about -0.18 to -0.21. A hand strap for the right hand is a leatherLight band on the treble back with a pearl-studded plate, and a left bass strap with a chrome adjuster on the bass back. Stitch-colour seam lines run along every strap. Chrome strap-anchor plates with gold screws sit at strapTrebleAnchor and strapBassAnchor. A pearlWhite back plaque with a gold border on each cabinet's back face carries a small maker's inscription made of tiny gold bars. Hanging tassels optional.
parts.attaches: Anchors at strapTrebleAnchor and strapBassAnchor, on the back faces of the two cabinets (z=-0.14). Nothing touches the floor.
